As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation.

About The Role

QA roles usually mean owning one product. Ours doesn't work that way.

At SINGU, the QA team works across the entire product group. Any given month you might be setting up a new automation project from zero, going deep on an API regression suite, or prototyping something in security or performance. Our recent QA hires joined specifically because nothing else looked this open-ended.

We're growing the team and hiring three Regular QA Engineers.

What you'll do:

  • Build and maintain automated tests across multiple SINGU products – web and API as the baseline, with optional depth in security, performance, accessibility, or mobile
  • Set up new automation projects from scratch. You're not inheriting someone else's flaky suite
  • Write tests in Playwright (TypeScript) and ship them through Jenkins / Bitbucket Pipelines
  • Pick a specialization that fits your interest and run with it – there's real demand across the board
  • Contribute to QA standards and practices across the group

Your development path – partly your call, partly ours

This is the part most of our recent hires said sold them on the role. Where you go deeper is a conversation: your interests on one side, what the business needs most at the moment on the other. We meet in the middle, and it actually works – people here have shifted focus as priorities and interests evolved.

The directions we have real demand for:

  • Security — ZAP, dynamic scanners, OWASP. We'd love one of the three hires to know this space or actively want to grow into it. Not a pentester role, but real security work in a QA context.
  • Performance testing — open space to build this out.
  • Accessibility — room to own it and shape how we approach it.
  • Mobile — we already have two engineers focused on this, so mobile depth is welcome but not required. If it interests you, there's room to plug in.
  • End-to-end and API automation — the bread and butter, and where most of the team's time goes.

You'll thrive here if:

  • You've shipped production test automation as a Regular QA Engineer
  • You're hands-on with Playwright or Cypress in TypeScript
  • You're comfortable with API testing (REST, HTTP, JSON)
  • You want to write code, not click through manual scripts – this role is 100% automation
  • You can run with autonomy and don't need someone scheduling your week
  • You speak fluent Polish and English (B2/C1) – both used daily across the team and the wider group

Nice to have:

  • CI/CD pipeline experience (Jenkins, Bitbucket Pipelines, or similar)
  • Security testing — OWASP Top 10, ZAP, dynamic scanners
  • Track record of setting up automation projects from zero
  • Agile / Scrum team experience
  • Understanding of test environments and test data management

Honest notes:

  • The dev side has substantial legacy (PHP, .NET). That's part of why QA matters here — your automation is the safety net for refactoring and migration work happening in parallel. The QA stack itself is modern.
  • The team is small and the structure is light. We move fast and expect you to figure things out. If you want a fully laid-out playbook, this isn't it.

We hire on automation, but functional testing instinct still matters — you're testing real products used by real customers, not just writing scripts.

💰Competitive Salary Range – Depending on your experience, we offer between 15'000 - 18'500 PLN net on a B2B contract, or 12'500 – 15'400 PLN gross on Contract of Employment.

🤝 A fantastic, engaged, and experienced team – Collaborate with passionate people who love what they do.

🎯 An environment open to innovation – We embrace creativity and new ideas in a dynamic setting.

🏡 A family-like atmosphere with a "you" culture – in a company that values "we".

🍏 Top-notch Apple equipment – The best tools to do your best work.

🥐 Monthly themed breakfasts – Start your day with great food & company.

  • Strong experience with embedded Linux, kernel drivers, device trees, and bootloaders.

  • Scripting experience using Python, TCL, or Bash.
  • Knowledge of PCIe, DDR, Ethernet, or DSP toolchains.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to work on cutting-edge quantum-secure communication technology.

  • High autonomy and ownership in a small, highly skilled engineering team.
  • Collaboration within a strong European deep-tech ecosystem supported by EU programmes and leading investors.
  • Long-term growth opportunities into specialist or technical leadership roles.

If you are excited about building cutting-edge quantum communication technology at the intersection of embedded Linux and FPGA development, we would love to hear from you.
